name: superstacks
description: Use for planning, TDD, verification loops, constraints, gardening, review, PRs, debugging, and ticket pipelines. Lean MIT skill stack for coding agents.

interface.longDescription: Superstacks is a small MIT-licensed set of coding-agent skills: discovery, plans in the pull request body, test-driven development, verify-loop, verification before any success claim, two-axis review, draft pull requests, optional interrogate for one-way doors, constraints, gardening, and design grilling. Skills may tell the agent to run optional local helpers (git diff/log, a user-supplied test command, or an existing Playwright install). The plugin makes no network calls, collects no telemetry, and does not read credentials.
defaultPrompt: Write the plan in the PR body, then keep the pull request draft.
Run TDD and verify-loop: name the check, fail it first, then go green.
Do a two-axis code review, then open a draft pull request only.

publication.release_notes: 6.1.1 marketplace readiness: Claude marketplace metadata, truthful helper-script wording, Codex Developer Tools listing, and flat per-skill zips.
